data.name: AlertsIntro
data.value: Manage favorites and their local reminders. By default, all favorites can alert regardless of collection status. Uncaught only uses the final collection status with manual overrides first and excludes Unknown. List filters are independent. Normal time/weather windows do not establish personal readiness.

data.name: AlertsLeadRange
data.value: Range: {0}–{1} real minutes. Settings are shared; delivery records are separate for each character.

data.name: AlertsPolicy
data.value: Only future reminders are armed. Login, reload, settings changes and long pauses never replay missed alerts. Saved per-character window records prevent duplicates. Each channel is a local display type; no message is sent to other players. One selected sound plays per batch, with default channel sounds silenced. Optional popups share the same reservation and are not retried if output fails. Time/weather windows do not establish personal readiness.

data.name: AlertsWaitingCharacter

data.name: AlertsStorageUnavailable
